correctness.rationale: The graph and invariant are explicit. Exhaustive enumeration gives exactly eight independent triples and 124 nonempty faces. The stated 60-pair matching leaves one critical 0-cell and three critical 2-cells, and the embedded verifier checks all 368 oriented Hasse edges and proves acyclicity by a complete topological sort. Forman's theorem then gives the stated wedge. A separate mod-2 boundary computation yields Betti vector \((1,0,3,0,0)\), agreeing with the wedge.
